fullContentHtml:
SSC MTS Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Final Result for the post of MTS / Havaldar. This recruitment was released for 7,948 posts. Applications for the SSC MTS / Havaldar Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 26 June 2025 to 24 July 2025. The PET/PST examination was held on 24-31 August 2026. Candidates who qualified for this written examination can download their SSC MTS / Havaldar Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 June 2025
  • Last Date : 24 July 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 July 2025
  • Online Correction Date : 04-06 August 2025
  • Self-Slot Booking Start : From 15 January 2026
  • Exam Start : From 04 February 2026
  • Exam Self Slot Booking : 16-25 January 2026
  • Application Status : 28 January 2026
  • Exam City Details : 30 January 2026
  • Admit Card : 02 February 2026
  • Answer Key : 03 March 2026
  • Result : 03 August 2026
  • PET/PST Exam Date : 24-31 August 2026
  • Final Result : 07 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SSC MTS Final Result 2026?

SSC MTS Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
